usage: Use 小學 to talk about the first stage of formal schooling, usually for children aged about 6 to 12.
It is a very common, neutral word in everyday Hong Kong Cantonese and works well in both speaking and writing.
Common collocations include 讀小學, 入小學, 小學老師, and 小學同學.
For learners, 小學 is the standard term for 'primary school'; it is not usually shortened in normal conversation.
